review: 721.2a-1: base expected called the noncreature Frigate '3/5 printed'; a noncreature permanent has no power or toughness, reworded.
721.4-1: does_not_fire variant bears_tapped flipped cost payability (no untapped creature to tap), not 721.4; dropped it and noted that the unconditional rule has no does_not_fire branch.

scenarios.title: A station symbol grants its abilities only while the permanent has enough charge counters

setup.notes: Lumen-Class Frigate has STATION 2+ (other creatures you control get +1/+1) and STATION 12+ (flying, lifelink, creature). The counters are charge counters.

decisions: No spell or ability is used; both players pass priority with the stack empty and the board is observed after the state-based check.

variants.label: two_counters
variants.expected: Lumen-Class Frigate has 2 charge counters, meets STATION 2+ and gives its anthem: Grizzly Bears is 3/3. Lumen-Class Frigate is a noncreature artifact with no power or toughness and no flying or lifelink. B's Hill Giant stays 3/3.

variants.label: one_counter
variants.delta: Lumen-Class Frigate has 1 charge counter instead of 2.
variants.expected: Lumen-Class Frigate has 1 charge counter, below STATION 2+, and gives no anthem: Grizzly Bears is 2/2. Lumen-Class Frigate is not a creature.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge implements the station symbol as a static ability with Affected$ Card.Self+counters_GE2_CHARGE.

scenarios.title: A station symbol with a power/toughness box makes the permanent a creature with that base power and toughness

setup.notes: Rescue Skiff is a noncreature artifact Spacecraft with STATION 10+ (flying, 5/6 creature). It is already on the battlefield, so its enters trigger does not happen.

decisions: No spell or ability is used; both players pass priority with the stack empty and the board is observed after the state-based check.

variants.label: ten_counters
variants.expected: Rescue Skiff has 10 charge counters and is an artifact creature with base power and toughness 5/6 and flying. It stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: nine_counters
variants.delta: Rescue Skiff has 9 charge counters instead of 10.
variants.expected: Rescue Skiff has 9 charge counters, below STATION 10+: it is a noncreature artifact Spacecraft with no power or toughness in play and no flying. It stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: The station ability is activatable at any counter count; abilities behind a station symbol need the counters

setup.notes: Debris Field Crusher has the station ability (tap another untapped creature you control: put charge counters equal to its power on it; sorcery speed) and STATION 8+ (creature, flying, {1}{R}: +2/+0 until end of turn). The stack is empty. The candidates are the station ability and the {1}{R} pump ability.

decisions: Both candidates are evaluated by the engine for A; nothing is activated.

variants.label: seven_counters
variants.expected: The station ability is legal to activate (can_play true, its cost taps Grizzly Bears). The {1}{R} pump ability is not available (can_play false) because Debris Field Crusher has 7 charge counters, below STATION 8+.

variants.label: zero_counters
variants.delta: Debris Field Crusher has 0 charge counters instead of 7.
variants.expected: The station ability is legal to activate (can_play true). The {1}{R} pump ability is not available (can_play false).

variants.label: eight_counters
variants.delta: Debris Field Crusher has 8 charge counters instead of 7.
variants.expected: The station ability is legal to activate (can_play true) and the {1}{R} pump ability is also available (can_play true, payable with the two Mountains), because STATION 8+ is met.

scenarios.forge_notes: The station keyword is K:Station:8 in Forge; the striated abilities are added by a static ability conditioned on counters_GE8_CHARGE. 721.4 is unconditional, so it has no does_not_fire branch of its own; the contrast is the striated pump ability, gated in seven_counters and zero_counters and available in eight_counters.
